title: Contextual word representations
text: Embeddings place words with related meanings near one another, allowing models to compare concepts even when wording differs.

title: Neural language models
text: A language model learns patterns from text and predicts a likely next token using the words that came before it.

title: Medical image learning
text: Convolutional neural networks can learn visual patterns in scans and support classification of medical images.

title: Retrieval augmented generation
text: A retrieval system can find relevant passages and provide them as context before a language model writes an answer.

title: Unsupervised representation learning
text: Unsupervised learning methods organize examples by structure without requiring a human label for every document.

title: Evaluating text embeddings
text: Text embeddings can be evaluated by checking whether paraphrases and related concepts receive higher similarity scores than unrelated examples.

title: Detecting disease in scans
text: Radiologists use medical imaging to inspect tissue and identify signs of disease in X-rays, CT scans, and MRI studies.

title: Personalized treatment planning
text: Clinical decision support combines patient history and test results to help clinicians compare treatment options for an individual.

title: Hospital readmission risk
text: Predictive models can estimate which patients may return to hospital soon after discharge so care teams can plan follow-up support.

title: Electronic health records
text: A well-designed patient record system helps clinicians find medication history, diagnoses, allergies, and test results during care.

title: Public health surveillance
text: Health agencies monitor changes in reported illness to detect outbreaks and direct limited medical resources.

title: Privacy in medical data
text: Healthcare analytics must protect patient confidentiality while enabling careful study of clinical information.

title: Renewable electricity storage
text: Large batteries store surplus electricity from wind and solar farms and release power when generation drops.

title: Urban heat reduction
text: Cities can reduce heat exposure with shade trees, reflective roofs, parks, and cooler building materials.

title: Measuring carbon emissions
text: Climate inventories estimate greenhouse gas emissions from transport, industry, buildings, and electricity use.

title: Coastal flood adaptation
text: Coastal communities combine wetland restoration, drainage improvements, and building plans to prepare for rising water.

title: Low carbon transport
text: Reliable public transit, cycling routes, and electric buses can reduce pollution from urban travel.

title: Climate forecasting
text: Climate models simulate long-term interactions between the atmosphere, oceans, land, and ice under different emissions pathways.

title: Phishing email detection
text: Security filters identify suspicious messages that imitate trusted organizations and attempt to steal login credentials.

title: Password storage
text: Web services should store salted password hashes rather than readable passwords to limit harm after a database breach.

title: Network intrusion monitoring
text: Intrusion detection systems inspect network activity for patterns that may signal unauthorized access or malware.

title: Encryption in transit
text: Transport encryption protects information as it moves between a user's browser and an online service.

title: Software supply chain risk
text: Dependency scanning helps teams find vulnerable third-party packages before they are deployed.

title: Multi factor authentication
text: A second verification step makes account takeover harder when an attacker has learned a user's password.

title: Multiplayer game latency
text: Online games use nearby servers and efficient message handling to reduce delays between player actions.

title: Database indexing
text: Database indexes speed up common searches by allowing a system to locate matching records without scanning every row.

title: Distributed service reliability
text: Replicated services and health checks help an application continue working when an individual machine fails.

title: Operating system memory
text: Memory managers allocate space to active programs and reclaim resources when applications finish using them.

title: Scalable web architecture
text: Load balancers distribute requests across servers so a website can handle traffic spikes more reliably.

title: Network protocol design
text: Communication protocols define how computers format, send, acknowledge, and recover from lost messages.
